notes.title: Patch v21
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We would like to thank everyone for their patience. We are happy to deploy our first patch. Big thanks to the community for reporting bugs and sendig tips how to make the game even better.
Our primary goal was to make the VR experience the best, for this we had to rework the scenery in every level. This took a long time, thank you for your patience again!

VR will be available as a launch option when starting up the game after updating. Currently HTC Vive is supported, Oculus Rift support is in the works.

Patch Notes:
- Fixed achievements reporting (HUGE thanks to merfab76!)
- Fixed localization errors
- Fixed game not launching in fullscreen
- Fixed game not launching in native resolution
- Fixed gamepad input problems
- Fixed SSAO artifacts
- Fixed sound issues in VR
- Minor rendering fixes
- redesigned level scenery for VR
- redesigned user interface for VR

Currently supported gamepads:
- Microsoft XBOX 360 gamepad
- Microsoft XBOX One gamepad
- Sony Playstation 4 gamepad
- Steam Controller
- Logitech RumblePad 2
- Logitech Cordless RumblePad 2
- Logitech Precision  gamepad
- Logitech Chillstream
